req.title: 404 on unknown task id
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 404 and detail 'Task not found' when the id does not exist.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-009 requires HTTP 404 with a specific detail message when GET /tasks/{task_id} is called with a non-existent ID. To achieve high mutation kill rate we need: (1) a positive case confirming a known ID returns 200 (catches status-code mutations and wrong-branch mutations), (2) a negative case confirming a clearly non-existent ID returns exactly 404 with the exact detail string (catches status-code constant mutations, string mutations, and wrong-branch mutations), (3) a boundary case at task_id=21 (one above the highest seeded row=20) to catch off-by-one mutations in any range check, (4) a boundary case at task_id=0 or negative to probe the lower boundary, and (5) a case asserting the exact detail message format including the task_id interpolation to catch string-mutation operators. The pre-loaded database has IDs 1-20; IDs 21+ do not exist.

tests.name: test_get_existing_task_returns_200
preconditions: Task with id=1 exists with title='Read chapter 5'
expected: Response JSON contains id=1 and title='Read chapter 5'
trace: R-TASK-009: positive path — known ID must NOT trigger 404; catches mutations that always return 404 or flip the None-check branch
tests.executable:
import os, tempfile
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app import models
from app.database import get_db
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp()
db_path = os.path.join(tmp, 'test_pos.db')
engine = create_engine(f'sqlite:///{db_path}', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
Session = sessionmaker(bind=engine)
session = Session()
session.add(models.Task(id=1, title='Read chapter 5', description='Signal pulse ember', completed=True))
session.commit()
session.close()

def override_get_db():
    db = Session()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_existing_task_returns_200():
    r = client.get('/tasks/1')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body['id'] == 1
    assert body['title'] == 'Read chapter 5'
    assert body['completed'] is True

test_get_existing_task_returns_200()
app.dependency_overrides.clear()
